definition.zh-TW: 營業收入是資本支出的幾倍，也就是 CE intensity 的倒數。倍數越高表示每一份資本支出帶出越多營收；兩者的資訊相同。
definition.en: Revenue as a multiple of capital expenditure, the reciprocal of capex intensity. A higher multiple means each unit of capital spending generates more revenue; the two carry the same information.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
